'''Anžejs Pasečņiks''' ({{IPA|lv|'an.ʒɛ͡is 'pa.sɛt͡ʃ.ɲiks}}; born 20 December 1995) is a Latvian professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Petkim Spor]] of the [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]].

==Professional career==
===VEF Rīga (2012–2015)===
He made his professional debut in the Latvian League with [[BK VEF Rīga|VEF Rīga]] in 2012.<ref>{{cite web|title=PASECNIKS, ANZEJS|url=http://www.euroleague.net/competition/players/showplayer?gamecode=2&pcode=003921|website=www.euroleague.net|access-date=16 August 2017}}</ref>

===Herbalife Gran Canaria (2015–2019)===
In August 2015, Pasečņiks signed with the Spanish club [[CB Gran Canaria|Herbalife Gran Canaria]]. He would play in its reserve team, club of the [[Liga EBA]], fourth division.<ref>{{cite web|title=Anzejs Pasecniks jugará en liga EBA con el Gran Canaria|url=http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=115222|website=www.acb.com|access-date=13 August 2015|language=es-ES|date=13 August 2015|archive-date=5 October 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151005035236/http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=115222|url-status=dead}}</ref> He debuted with the [[Liga ACB|ACB]] team in the [[2015 Supercopa de España de Baloncesto|Supercopa Endesa]].

===Washington Wizards / Capital City Go-Go (2019–2021)===
Pasečņiks was drafted by the [[Orlando Magic]] with the 25th overall pick in the first round of the [[2017 NBA draft]].<ref>{{cite web|title=NBA draft 2017 pick-by-pick recap: Markelle Fultz, Lonzo Ball are first two selections|url=http://www.latimes.com/sports/la-nba-draft-2017-live-updates-orlando-magic-take-anzejs-pasecniks-at-1498184589-htmlstory.html|website=Los Angeles Times|access-date=16 August 2017|date=22 June 2017}}</ref> He was immediately traded to the [[Philadelphia 76ers]] for future first-round and second-round picks.

On 1 July 2019, the Sixers renounced their draft right to Pasečņiks<ref>{{cite web|last1=Levick|first1=Noah|title=Sixers renounce rights to 2017 first-round pick, Anzejs Pasecniks, team source confirms|url=https://www.nbcsports.com/philadelphia/76ers/sixers-renounce-rights-2017-first-round-draft-pick-anzejs-pasecniks-team-source-confirms|website=NBC Sports|access-date=13 July 2019|date=1 July 2019}}</ref> and two days later, he joined the [[Washington Wizards]] summer league team.<ref>{{cite web|title=Sixers trade for Latvian center Anzejs Pasecniks after he was drafted by Magic|url=http://www.philly.com/philly/sports/sixers/philadelphia-76ers-nba-draft-anzejs-pasecniks-trade-orlando-magic.html|website=Philly.com|access-date=16 August 2017|date=22 June 2017}}</ref> On 16 October, he signed by the Wizards,<ref>{{cite web|title=Wizards sign Jones and Pasecniks|url=https://www.nba.com/wizards/wizards-sign-jalen-jones-anzejs-pasecniks|website=NBA.com|date=16 October 2019|access-date=16 October 2019}}</ref> but was waived three days later.<ref>{{cite tweet|author=Washington Wizards|title=OFFICIAL: We've waived C Anzejs Pasecniks and F Jalen Jones. #RepTheDistrict|number=1185622415407226880|user=WashWizards|date=19 October 2019|access-date=19 October 2019}}</ref> On 27 October, joined the [[Capital City Go-Go]].<ref>{{cite web|first=Kelly|last=Rakusin|title=GO-GO ANNOUNCE DRAFT PICKS, TRAINING CAMP ROSTER|url=https://capitalcity.gleague.nba.com/news/go-go-announce-draft-picks-training-camp-roster|website=NBA.com|date=27 October 2019|access-date=27 October 2019}}</ref> On 17 December, the Wizards announced that they had signed Pasečņiks to a [[two-way contract]].<ref>{{cite tweet|author=Washington Wizards|title=OFFICIAL: We've signed C Anzejs Pasceniks to a two-way contract and waived G Chris Chiozza. https://on.nba.com/36IsVPS|number=1207040011855683585|user=WashWizards|date=17 December 2019|access-date=17 December 2019}}</ref> On 18 December, Pasečņiks made his debut in the NBA, coming off from bench with nine points, eight rebounds and an assist in a 110–109 overtime loss to the [[Chicago Bulls]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Bulls rally from 18 down to beat Wizards in overtime|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=401161051|website=ESPN.com|date=18 December 2019|access-date=19 December 2019}}</ref> On 12 January 2020, the Wizards announced that they had signed Pasečņiks to a multi-year contract.<ref>{{cite web|title=Wizards sign Anzejs Pasecniks to multi-year deal|url=https://www.nba.com/wizards/wizards-sign-anzejs-pasecniks-multi-year-contract|website=NBA.com|date=12 January 2020|access-date=12 January 2020}}</ref> The Wizards waived Pasečņiks on 17 January 2021.<ref>{{cite web|first=Mike|last=DePrisco|title=Report: Wizards release center Anzejs Pasecniks|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/report-wizards-release-center-anzejs-204657115.html|website=Sports.Yahoo.com|date=17 January 2021|access-date=20 January ===Real Betis (2021–2022)===
On 9 November 2021, Pasečņiks signed with [[Real Betis Baloncesto|Real Betis]] of the Spanish [[Liga ACB]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Anzejs Pasecniks, nuevo jugador del Coosur Real Betis|url=https://www.acb.com/articulo/ver/298422-anzejs-pasecniks-nuevo-jugador-del-coosur-real-betis.html|website=ACB.com|date=9 November 2021|access-date=9 November 2021|language=Spanish}}</ref>

===Metropolitans 92 (2022–2023)===
On 30 November 2022, Pasečņiks signed with [[Metropolitans 92]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Anžejs Pasečņiks rejoint les Mets 92|url=https://www.metropolitans92.com/fr/actualites/2022-11-30/an-ejs-pase-iks-rejoint-les-mets-92|website=Metropolitans92.com|date=30 November 2022|access-date=30 November 2022|language=French}}</ref>

===Zunder Palencia (2023–2024)===
On 23 August 2023, Pasečņiks signed with [[Palencia Baloncesto|Zunder Palencia]].<ref>{{cite web|title=El Zunder Palencia firma al pívot letón Anzejs Pasecniks|url=https://www.europapress.es/deportes/futbol-00162/noticia-zunder-palencia-firma-pivot-leton-anzejs-pasecniks-20230814152957.html|website=EuropaPress.es|date=23 August 2023|access-date=11 August 2024|language=Spanish}}</ref>

On 12 August 2024, Pasečņiks signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Milwaukee Bucks]],<ref>{{cite web|title=MILWAUKEE BUCKS SIGN ANŽEJS PASEČŅIKS TO A TWO-WAY CONTRACT|url=https://wisconsin.gleague.nba.com/news/milwaukee-bucks-sign-anzejs-pasecniks-to-a-two-way-contract|website=NBA.com|date=12 August 2024|access-date=12 August 2024}}</ref> but was waived on 21 October.<ref>{{cite web|title=Milwaukee Bucks Convert Liam Robbins to a Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/milwaukee-bucks-convert-liam-robbins-to-a-two-way-contract/n-6158600|website=OurSportsCentral.com|date=21 October 2024|access-date=22 October 2024}}</ref>

===Tofaş (2024–2025)===
On 5 November 2024, Pasečņiks signed with [[Tofaş S.K.|Tofaş]] of the [[Basketbol Süper Ligi|Basketball Super League]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Ailemize Hoş Geldin: Anzejs Pasecniks|url=https://tofasspor.com/haber-3219-ailemize_hos_geldin_anzejs_pasecniks|website=TofasSpor.com|date=5 November 2024|access-date=5 November 2024|language=tr}}</ref>

===Hsinchu Toplus Lioneers (2025–2026)===
On August 13, 2025, Pasečņiks signed with the [[Hsinchu Toplus Lioneers]] of the [[Taiwan Professional Basketball League]] (TPBL).<ref>{{cite news |title=攻城獅洋將走歐洲風 拉脫維亞帕塞獅加盟 |url=https://sports.ettoday.net/news/3014512 |accessdate=August 13, 2025 |work=ETtoday |date=August 13, 2025 }}</ref>

===Petkim Spor (2026–present)===
On August 26, 2026, Pasečņiks signed with the [[Petkim Spor]] of the [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Aliağa Petkimspor, Uzun Rotasyonunu Anžejs Pasečņiks ile Renklerine Bağladı |url=https://www.aliagamedya.com/aliaga-petkimspor-uzun-rotasyonunu-an-ejs-pase-iks-ile-renklerine-bagladi/48115/ |accessdate=August 27, 2026 |work=Aliağa Medya |date=August 26, 2026 }}</ref>

==National team career==
He was a regular Latvia youth national team player. He helped [[Latvia men's national under-18 basketball team|Latvia's U-18 national team]] reach semi-finals at the [[2013 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]], where he was named to the All-Tournament Team, averaging 12.6 points and 7.7 rebounds at the tournament.
